title: Winter Cleaning
html:
Quest Giver: Shivery the Incorrigible Snowman

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Speak with Shivery the Incorrigible Snowman to travel to the Sanctuary of the Snowmen and kill 100 creatures in the the Sanctuary of the Snowmen.

Quest Reward: Gold and 4 King's Coins

Return to: Shivery the Incorrigible Snowman

Repeatable: No

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Speak with Shivery the Incorrigible Snowman to travel to the Sanctuary of the Snowmen and kill 100 creatures in the the Sanctuary of the Snowmen.

Offer:

What a little Dungeon Runner overachiever you are! Looking for more tasks?

Why don't you do some winter cleaning for me? The more creatures you clear out of the Sanctuary, the more lazy I can be... uhh... I mean... the greater pride you will feel as a Dungeon Runner! Return to me when you're done with this winter cleaning.

Turn-in:

A fresh clean Sanctuary! Just what Shivery wanted for the holidays.

Objectives:

  • Slay Creatures in the Sanctuary

Client level range: 5–?
